message.text: We are 11 people doing performance marketing for DACH e-commerce brands, about €60k a month. Client reporting is manual and my ops lead is leaving in December, so the process has to be automated before she goes. I need someone who can run this as a project starting in October. Proposal please, and a call to discuss.
message.subject: Reporting before December
